description: Canonical hostile replay classes for Epoch03 constitutional commons.

classes.name: Illegal Transition
classes.summary: Fixture attempts a transition absent from the canonical FSM.

classes.name: Missing Justification
classes.summary: Fixture attempts lawful-looking motion without a valid doctrine guard.

classes.name: Topology Drift
classes.summary: Fixture mutates FSM topology or attempts to use a forked topology.

classes.name: Semantic Drift
classes.summary: Fixture mutates doctrine meaning or guard semantics.

classes.name: Stale Receipt
classes.summary: Fixture replays old law or stale hashes against a newer verifier surface.

classes.name: Forked Receipt
classes.summary: Fixture presents evidence bound to a divergent Merkle root or receipt lineage.

classes.name: Authority Violation
classes.summary: Fixture attempts to preserve or reintroduce authority in terminal equilibrium.

classes.name: Temporal Violation
classes.summary: Fixture violates timestamp, ordering, or replay sequence constraints.

classes.name: Trace Incomplete
classes.summary: Fixture omits required finite trace data needed for deterministic replay.

classes.name: Revocation Failure
classes.summary: Fixture attempts continued execution after required revocation or terminal state.
